subject: Schedule: proposal to bridge sponsor coverage while CTO travels

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo — proposed bridge plan while CTO travels

Hi Samir / Elena,

Quick update — we heard that your CTO will be traveling the week of 22 Sep and may not be able to join the planned walkthrough on 23 Sep. We want to make sure the session still meets your evaluation needs while keeping the CTO involved without making them join the whole hour.

Suggested plan:
- Keep current session on 23 Sep at 10:00am PT but reframe first 15 minutes for an executive-level intro with your CTO (or VP sponsor).
- Rafael or Vivek will run the technical walkthrough for the remaining 45 minutes and handle deep-dive questions.
- We'll record the executive segment and share the short clip + key takeaways with your CTO afterward.

If that doesn't work, propose two alternatives where your CTO is available for the opening 15 mins: 24 Sep 09:30am PT or 25 Sep 11:00am PT.

Attached: redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf (slide deck) and a one-page mutual action plan.

Next step: say which option you prefer and whether your CTO can join the first 15 minutes or we should shift the full time.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the flexibility.

Short version: the CTO will be in transit on 23 Sep and can't reliably join any live window that day. He can do a short executive drop-in on either 24 Sep after 09:00am PT (best) or 25 Sep late morning, but both are tight.

Can we do this instead: keep the walkthrough on 23 Sep as-is with your technical lead running it; schedule a 15-minute executive sync (recorded + optional live) with our CTO on 24 Sep at 09:15am PT so he sees the top-level value and can give a quick thumbs up? That way the main demo proceeds on schedule for our broader team.

If the recorded executive intro is good enough and the CTO confirms asynchronously, we can proceed without moving the larger session.

—Samir
